title: Costume Silhouette Polish, Unique Elbow Strikes & Elemental Hit-Sparks
author: Antigravity Senior Technical Artist
objective: Refine costume tailoring, Portrait HUD clarity, character-specific elbow_strike poses, asymmetric uppercut balancing, character-signature hit-sparks, and eliminate remaining 404 favicon requests on Canvas preview pages.
requestedBehavior: 1. Costume & Portrait Polish: widen dinhAn's golden lion pauldrons horizontally while lifting his golden helmet brim slightly off brows for crisp Portrait HUD clarity; break up drapedOvercoat's stiff trapezoidal silhouette with waist taper and a swallow-tail coat vent; refine vanAnh's cigar angle/weight; compact nghi's chest name-tag; sculpt bichLam's sleeveless gi V-taper. 2. Unique elbow_strike & dunghai.uppercut symmetry fix: update fallback elbow_strike to protrude elbow forward with forearm folded down-back safely below chin, add bespoke elbow_strike poses to all 7 remaining heroes (nghi, vananh, tiendang, huavudai, bichlam, dunghai, giangmanh), and counterbalance dunghai.uppercut rear arm asymmetrically. 3. Elemental Hit-Sparks: add optional colorOpts parameter to EffectManager.prototype.createHitSparks and CharacterRegistry.getSparkColors(entity), wiring signature aura sparks in combat.js and preview_skill_showcase.html. 4. Eliminate 404 /favicon.ico request on harness/preview_character_canvas.html.
acceptanceCriteria: All 9 characters maintain 0 geometric face/eye/nose/mouth/chin overlaps across idle and all combat poses including custom elbow_strike
Each of the 9 characters defines an individualized elbow_strike pose clearly separated from punch_straight
dunghai.uppercut renders asymmetrically without V-framing the head
CharacterRegistry.getSparkColors and EffectManager.createHitSparks produce distinct per-character impact starbursts and shockwaves while keeping default behavior backward-compatible
Playwright captures across preview pages and index.html pass with 0 console errors and 0 HTTP 404 responses
